objective: Determine whether the numeric suffix of the official row_id contains a portable, row-local signal rather than file-order leakage.

allowed_inputs: open/data/train.csv rows from seasons 2019 through 2021 only
each row's own row_id and game_type
frozen exact-C predictions for validation seasons 2020 and 2021
forbidden_inputs: any 2022, 2023, or 2024 label or prediction metric
test-row counts, maxima, ordering, distribution, or relationships between test rows
features computed from any other validation or test row
policy_boundary.deployment_rule: At inference, only the current row's suffix may be parsed. No test-level centering, ranking, bin quantiles, or aggregation is allowed.
policy_boundary.documentation_semantics: open/data_description.md defines row_id only as a unique sample identifier used to match submissions.

source_protocol.position_definition: numeric row_id suffix minus the first suffix of that source season plus one
selection_order: maximum minimum full-score gain across the two transfers
prefer smaller alpha, larger prior, and larger block width

source_gate.semantic_portability: row_id must not be merely an exact encoding of CSV row position and its documented meaning must support ordered semantics
source_gate.pass_rule: all semantic and performance conditions must pass
source_gate.on_fail: close row_id as a deployable axis and do not open 2022+ for it
source_gate.on_pass: freeze one recipe in a new preregistration before any 2022 metric is read
